title: 4 CD Lot Jazz: Big Phat Band, Gary Burton Berklee, Smooth Jazz, Drum Fun
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Discs and jewel cases show normal light wear consistent with age/storage; the Big Phat Band case has price sticker residue on the back. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Lot of 4 pre-owned jazz CDs. Includes:

Gordon Goodwin's Big Phat Band - Swingin' For The Fences (Silverline, 2000)
Gary Burton and the Berklee All-Stars (JVC, 1986)
Smooth Jazz: Hear and Now - Various Artists (Jazz Alliance International, 2003)
Turn It Up & Lay It Down Vol. 4: The Road to Fast Bop - Spencer Strand / DrumFun (2006), a drum play-along CD

All 4 CDs, jewel cases, and pictured inserts/artwork are included. Items are pre-owned and may show normal cosmetic wear from age and storage. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents.

You will receive the exact CDs pictured.
